title: Red onion and chilli relish
preamble:
1 Garlic clove

Small red chilli

1 Table spoon brown sugar

2 Table spoon wine vinegar
method: Slowly fry onions for 20 mins in olive oil
Fry chopped garlic and chilli for 5 mins
Add sugar and vinegar and cook until liquid reduced
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
